author: Parsifal-2045
body: #### PR description This PR was co-developed by the NGT Task 3.1.1 team: @rovere, @mmusich, @JanGerritSchulz, @elenavernazza, @bfonta, @EmanueleCoradin together with inputs from @borzari and @AdrianoDee. Some of the developments were assisted by AI tools, including Claude (Sonnet / Opus / Fable) and Kimi K3. Wherever possible, we have tried to preserve co-authorship of commits, including both human and AI authors. In this PR we introduce a new heterogeneous collection of Outer-Tracker `VectorHits`, built on device following the existing fully serial `VectorHit` formalism. Additionally, the PixelTracking CA is re-envisioned and extended to take full advantage of hits from the Pixel detector and the aforementioned `VectorHits` in the OT. This is the first implementing PR for Iterative Tracking on Accelerators with Cellular Automaton (ITACA), further improvements to the fit and physics reach are expected to follow. Preliminary results for the full chain were shown at the [24/08 TRK POG meeting](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1719987/#1-update-on-extension-of-ca-an). ##### Main developments - New `reco::VectorHitsSoA` / `reco::OTRecHitsSoA` collections (`DataFormats/TrackingRecHitSoA`) with ROOT dictionaries. The CA reads pixel hits and vector hits through a single bounds-checked interface (`CAHitsView`), implemented with the same API as the existing SoAMultiView to maintain easy backwards compatibility via type aliasing - The vector hits implementation is bundled together with its validation via a new DQM module (+ harvesting) - OT RecHit conversion for pixel seeding (`hltPixelSeedingOTRecHitsSoA`), run-dependent stacked-module geometry (`StackedModuleGeometryESProducer`), and vector hits formation kernels (`Phase2OTVectorHitsSoAProducer`) - The cellular automaton is extended to the full tracker, with pixelvector hit and vector hitvector hit doublets, vector-hit-curvature-based triplet criteria, and an optional in-kernel triplet/track DNN (compile-time weight banks, off by default to not change physics, but enabled for the VectorHit configuration) - To better integrate these developments into the full tracking chain at HLT, the `removeOTRechits` flag found in the `SeedGeneratorFromProtoTracksEDProducer` (`hltInitialStepSeeds`) has been modified to feed the same seeds for both the default (extended) PixelTracks and the vector-hit based ones. In particular, the flag is now turned on by default with no change in the behaviour for the default chain, since it keeps all hits from the IT and P hits from OT PS modules in the barrel - The CA kernels and fit orchestration are now split per topology (`Phase1` / `HIonPhase1` / `Phase2` / `Phase2OT` / `Phase2OTVectorHits`) to reduce single-TU compile times - The CA can now optionally rely on two in-kernel DNNs (with weights saved as constants in header files) to select High-Purity triplets (`useTripletDNN`) and assign tight quality to tracks (`useTrackDNN`). Again, these flags are only turned on for the new vector-hit-based CA. Furthermore, for this updated configuration, the final HP selection has replaced the torch DNN with a compact gradient-boosted forest - Another new CA flag, `useExactAllocations`, was introduced to allow to further reduce the memory footprint on GPU by computing the exact number of doublets before allocating their container. This leads to another potential memory saving, but comes at the cost of one event synchronisation, whose impact on timing strongly depends on how full the GPU queue is. The flag is disabled by default, since the trade-off is not currently worth it and memory reduction has been achieved in other key areas by cost-free developments - A lot of developments have gone into reducing the memory footprint of the entire CA chain. While most benefits are observed when using vector hits, the default configuration also benefits from some improvements that specifically targeted the heaviest consumers of memory (doublets, triplets, tracks) - Some other miscellaneous improvements include `OneToManyAssoc` zeroing using a device memset and `bulkFill` gaining a content-capacity overflow guard #### PR validation - Running `scram b runtests` locally shows no failures - `runTheMatrix.py -l limited -i all --ibeos` runs fine locally - Physics performance has been validated on a few samples (TTbar, high pT QCD and Z' M6000), showing PixelTracks efficiency on par or slightly better with respect to the current baseline, with much improved resolutions and reduced fake rate: [Efficiency vs eta](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/CAVectorHits/MTV/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-04-0000/TTbar/hltPhase2Pixel_hltAssociatorByHits/effic.png) | [Efficiency vs pT](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/CAVectorHits/MTV/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-04-0000/TTbar/hltPhase2Pixel_hltAssociatorByHits/efficPt.png) :-------------------------:|:-------------------------: | [Fake rate vs eta](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/CAVectorHits/MTV/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-04-0000/TTbar/hltPhase2Pixel_hltAssociatorByHits/fakerate.png) | [pT resolution](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/CAVectorHits/MTV/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-04-0000/TTbar/hltPhase2Pixel_hltAssociatorByHits/ptres_vs_eta_Sigma.png) | All plots are available [here](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/CAVectorHits/MTV/) (originally produced with `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-04-0000`, updated with `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-16-1000`) **Note** A new workflow such as `37834.7512` can be used to test this part of the new ITACA prompt iteration on TTBar 200 PU. The old "PixelTriplets" workflows (offsets .406-.408) have been replaced with the new ITACA prompt iteration equivalents (validation and profiling) This PR also changes the default behaviour of the `ngtScouting` procModifier, replacing the extended PixelTracks with ITACA prompt iteration **Review note** A significant number of new files and added lines come from the new compiled-in DNNs and the scripts to easily retrain them and the new forest (or existing HP DNN)
title: [NGT] Implement heterogeneous VectorHits, their validation, and use them in the CA
